design.external_reference: scenicplus==1.0.0 (GBM r2g + arboreto GBM tf2g + GSEA eRegulons)

governance.caveat: Candidate eRegulons combine PWM sequence matches, cis peak-to-gene co-variation, and TF-to-target expression correlation across paired cells; they represent associative regulatory candidates (subject to paralog motif sharing and indirect co-expression) and do not establish causal regulation without independent perturbation or binding assays.
